note: Shim coverage model for runner/shims/bun-polyfill-v1.js.txt, consumed by scripts/scan-bun-api.mjs. One entry per top-level key of the polyfill's Bun object; tests assert this file stays in lockstep with the payload. status: full = behaviorally equivalent for the bundle's usage; degraded = works but with the listed caveat; throws = intentionally unimplemented. API names only — no bundle content.

version.caveat: stub '0.0.0-node-shim'; version gates comparing against real Bun releases misbehave

revision.caveat: stub 'node-shim' string, not a real Bun revision hash

stringWidth.caveat: best-effort approximation (ANSI strip + wide-char ranges), not Bun's full Unicode width tables

wrapAnsi.caveat: minimal wrapper; no word-boundary breaking, partial ANSI sequence handling

hash.caveat: FNV-1a 32-bit, not Wyhash64; values differ from real Bun — uniqueness only, never persist/compare across runtimes

which.caveat: spawnSync of `which` with 1s timeout; blocks the event loop briefly, POSIX only

spawn.caveat: sync spawnSync, 5s cap, blocks event loop; no streaming stdio, no PTY, no argv0, kill() is a no-op

gc.caveat: no-op; does not trigger Node GC

generateHeapSnapshot.caveat: no-op; returns an empty buffer instead of a v8 snapshot

semver.caveat: full only when the semver package resolves; otherwise naive numeric compare and satisfies() always false

deepEquals.caveat: pure-JS structural compare (cycle-safe; Date/RegExp/Map/Set/typed arrays) — symbol keys and exotic class semantics not compared; equivalent for the bundle's plain-data call site

JSONL.caveat: undefined — only safe behind optional chaining (Bun.JSONL?.parseChunk)

YAML.caveat: js-yaml when resolvable; otherwise a JSON-parse fallback that cannot read real YAML

embeddedFiles.caveat: always an empty array; embedded-asset code paths see 'no embedded files'

Terminal.caveat: PTY emulator needs native bindings; throws by design so callers take their Node fallback path

SQL.caveat: gateway-only Postgres client; throws by design — `claude gateway` is Bun-only upstream and unreachable from the interactive CLI

serve.caveat: gateway-only HTTP server; throws by design — `claude gateway` is Bun-only upstream and unreachable from the interactive CLI

Transpiler.caveat: transformSync/transform return input unchanged; no actual transpilation (REPL paths only)

argv.caveat: Node argv shape: argv[0] is the node binary path, not 'bun'

stdin.caveat: Node Readable stream, not a BunFile — no .text(), .json(), or .stream()

stdout.caveat: Node Writable stream, not a BunFile — no writer()/flush()

stderr.caveat: Node Writable stream, not a BunFile — no writer()/flush()

file.caveat: text/arrayBuffer/stream/exists only; no .json(), .writer(), slice(), or size/type metadata

write.caveat: sync writeFileSync of string/Buffer only; no BunFile/Response/stream sources

plugin.caveat: no-op; bundler plugin registration is silently ignored
